blind.description: A stylized medieval cooking station consisting of a wooden crane/gantry with iron reinforcements and a cross base, from which a large dark metal cauldron hangs via a chain and bail handle over a square stone-lined firepit containing unlit wood logs and ash. Surfaces are clean, solid, and stylized with hand-painted textures; materials include brown wood, dark charcoal metal with edge highlights, and grey cobblestone/firewood. There are no active flames or glow.
blind.from_above: From straight above, it shows a cross-shaped wooden base to the left with a horizontal beam projecting over a square stone hearth; the circular opening and rim of the dark cauldron are visible beneath the beam, flanked by its bail handle rings.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4.2 feet tall (around three-quarters the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 4 feet wide across the base and hearth combined.
